units: B. Kam. 30ᵃ שעת הוֹצָאַת זבלים the season for carrying out dung; a. fr.—הוֹצָאַת המת funeral escort.
Meg. 3ᵇ; a. e.—Esp. (with ref. to Sabbath law) carrying out of the house, in gen. transferring an object from one territory to another (from private to public ground a. vice versa, v. רָשׁוּת).
<cite ref="Shabbat 2b:12">Sabb. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>שתים דה׳</he> two forbidden acts in taking out of the house, opp. <cite ref="E00518"><he>הכנסה</he></cite>, carrying in.
Ib. תנא הכנסה נמי ה׳ וכ׳ the teacher of the Mishnah calls the carrying in, too, hotsaah (Mish. יְצִיאָה), transfer.
Ib. כל עקירת … ה׳ וכ׳ any removal of an object from its place is implied in the term hotsaah. Y. ib. I, 2ᵇ; a. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 5:1:6">Y. Shebi. V, 35ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מהוצאת עלין</he> from the time that the leaves come forth.

senses.gloss: ה׳ נפש the escape of life, last dying movement.
the time consumed by the laborer to go out to the field.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 72:4">Gen. R. s. 72</cite> <he>ה׳ מִשֶּׁל בעה״ב</he> the time for going out to the place of labor is included in the working hours belonging to the employer (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 83b">B. Mets. 83ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="J00527"><he>יציאה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 4:1:4">Y. Peah IV, beg. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ משל בעה״ב</he> the cost (of cutting the fruits of the tree) must be borne by the owner (and not by the poor). Y. Shek. I, end, 46ᵇ <he>ה׳ דרכים</he> expense for keeping the roads in repair.
<cite ref="Ketubot 80a:4">Keth. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>אם הי׳ שבח יתר על הה׳</he> if the income from the improvement exceeds the outlay.
<cite ref="Shabbat 117b">Sabb. 117ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ שבת</he> the marketing for the Sabbath; a. fr.—Pl. <he>הוֹצָאוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 8:5">Keth. VIII, 5</cite> <he>המוציא ה׳ על וכ׳</he> if one spends money for improving his wife’s estate.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:20">Num. R. s. 14</cite>, end <he>כמה ה׳ יוצאות וכ׳</he> how large the expenses are for the royal table; a. fr.
